name: NASA TR R-100 config 78 (cylindrical afterbody, fins excluded)
_notes: Stoney (1961), NASA TR R-100, config 78 data sheet, PDF page 95. d = 1.50 in = 0.0381 m; l_N/d = 7.13 full parabola; cylindrical afterbody l_A/d = 1.78; no midbody; NO fins. Same construction as r100-92.json / r100-98.json.

Used only as the REFERENCE body for the cdDelta increments of configs 79-83 (the same-length cylinder). The measured increment C_D,T(config) - C_D,T(78) cancels the identical nose and fins; the kernel increment is formed between two finless bodies for the same reason.
